column4: 'sight' overlaps with 'vision' and 'eyesight' meanings of gezicht, duplicating the other senses.
Meaning 1 and 2 are the same sense of 'des te' (all the more), so one is a duplicate and the other should be kept.
Hol is het-word; 'run' belongs to the adjective/verb 'hol' (op hol slaan), and this duplicates other meanings under the wrong article.
The meaning 'sloping road' is a place-name-like gloss on a common word and is obscure (hol is mainly 'hole/burrow' etc.), so it only confuses learners.
'Flat surface' is a noun-like sense that duplicates the basic meaning 'flat' of the adjective.
The 'dismissal from military service' sense is obscure and the 'ticket' sense is also doubtful, so this meaning only confuses a learner; passport is the real meaning.
The archaic "to mean" has no example and is obscure; the sense "to mean" is already listed elsewhere, so it duplicates.
Archaic transitive "to name" (iemand iets heten) is obscure, and the example actually uses the intransitive "to be called", so it duplicates another meaning.
To stir is not a meaning of heten; it is a confusion with another word (roeren), so this meaning does not exist.
Scumbag and jerk (insult) are essentially the same insulting meaning of rotzak, so this duplicates the other meaning.
Approval and go-ahead are the same meaning as the other listed meaning go, so it is a duplicate.
'To give birth' and 'to have young' are the same meaning of jongen, so this duplicates the other entry.
Duplicates the other meaning 'underground train', which says the same thing.
It duplicates the 'at the back' meaning of the other achteraan entry, and the part of speech is the same wrong one.
The archaic 'foundation' sense is obscure and only confuses a learner, and the common meanings are already listed.
'To look over' largely duplicates 'to check' (item 3) and the other listed meanings.
It is nearly the same meaning as the other entry (past the crisis), so it is a duplicate.
Archaic 'something boiled' is obscure and only confuses learners.
Spuit meaning 'gun' is archaic and obscure, and the example is unnatural, so it would only confuse a learner.
It exactly duplicates meaning 1 and is wrongly marked archaic, since this sense is current Dutch.
This 'goat (Capra aegagrus)' entry duplicates the other 'goat' meaning.
afgaan meaning "to defecate" is a rare, vulgar-ish usage ("afgaan" is not really used for this) and is not a standard meaning that learners need.
'Movie outing' duplicates the cinema meaning, since going to the bioscoop is just the cinema.
'eastwards' duplicates the 'east' meaning of the same adverb.
'Forced estate' is a obscure legal sense (wettelijk erfdeel is not called reserve in everyday use) and confuses learners; other meanings cover the word.
Een wolk van een baby is a real idiom, but "wolk" itself does not mean a bouncing baby, and a learner would be misled by listing it as a separate sense.
The paal as an Indonesian distance measure is obscure and only confuses a learner.
Paal does not mean 'pale' (that is an English word); this meaning does not exist in Dutch.
Paal does not mean 'peel'; this meaning does not exist in Dutch.
It duplicates item 4, which has the same meaning with 'house specialty'.
Talks is essentially the same meaning as consultation and duplicates item 1.
Curly-haired person as a vulgar meaning of schaap is not a real, recognized usage and only confuses learners.
'Undisciplined' is not a distinct sense of slordig and overlaps with sloppy/unkempt, so it duplicates the other meanings.
'Union' is essentially the same as 'alliance' for verbond, so it duplicates the other meaning.
Hoogtepunt does not mean altitude (that is hoogte); the 'high point' meaning already exists as another entry.
The meaning overlaps with the other listed meaning 'involvement', and the example is essentially the same sense, so this is a duplicate.
The conjunction 'like' duplicates the existing meaning 'as' and adds nothing for a learner.
Closing off a road is already covered by 'to block' and 'to blockade', so it is a duplicate.
civil service is not a normal meaning of administratie and it duplicates the other administration senses.
It duplicates the other meaning, "mentally retarded person", which is the same slur.
kit as a metal can is not a Dutch meaning; the word means sealant/putty or a kit, so this meaning does not exist.
To doff (take off clothing) is archaic and obscure; the common meaning is covered by the other entry (ontdoen van = get rid of).
Zwijn does not mean bicycle; this meaning does not exist and the other meanings already cover pig/swine.
Rag is not a real meaning of 'vel'; the sense of a sheet of paper is already covered by 'sheet'.
It duplicates meaning 1, and its example is unnatural and circular.
A vuilnisbak is not a mongrel dog; this meaning does not exist and rubbish bin is already listed.
This sense duplicates the other 'concentration' meaning and is not distinct enough for a learner.
Look in Dutch means chives or the English-style 'look'; 'section' is not a meaning, and 'gap' is also dubious, so this meaning does not exist.
The 'low-lying streamlined car' sense is archaic and obscure and only confuses a learner, while the main torpedo meaning is already listed.
The meaning 'eyebag' is not a real meaning of 'wal' and is a spurious entry confused with other words; it also duplicates the 'periorbital dark circle' meaning listed elsewhere.
bug is just a looser rendering of insect, which is already listed as another meaning.
violator duplicates the rapist meaning and is archaic and confusing.
The plural 'the above seeds' only repeats the peanut meaning and is not a separate sense.
Transference is essentially the same as the listed meanings transfer/transmission, so it duplicates them.
The sexual sense is a spurious meaning of the idiom, and the main meaning is covered by the other entry.
'Doomed to die' duplicates the 'doomed' meaning kept in item 1.
'Near death' is essentially the same sense as 'doomed' and is covered by item 1.
A raise in salary is a stretch for verbetering (that would be loonsverhoging) and it is essentially covered by the meaning improvement.
Reparation is not a normal meaning of verbetering (that is herstel or schadevergoeding), so it only confuses learners.
The Laser dinghy is a specific brand sense that duplicates the general meaning 'laser' and only adds confusion.
Aandoening can mean an emotion only in archaic usage (as in 'ontroering'), so this meaning only confuses a learner; the ailment sense remains.
Archaic and obscure meaning 'to be busy' is not a real current sense; the vomit meaning remains.
Garbled fragment that duplicates the back seat meaning and has no separate sense.
'Modernist' is an obscure sense that hardly differs from 'modern', and the example only shows the ordinary meaning, so it duplicates meaning 2.
'small' is not a meaning of lila; it is a wrong meaning with no example.
'Wreck' is a result of the collision, not a separate meaning of botsing, and duplicates 'collision'.
The fluyt is an obscure historical ship type and this meaning would only confuse a learner; flute and whistle already cover the common senses.
This is an archaic, obscure sense of 'homosexual' that is offensive and confuses learners, and it is not the common use of flik.
Japonic is a linguistic term that confuses learners and the meaning duplicates the existing "Japanese" sense.
large is not a noun meaning of gesticht and is wrong, so the sense does not exist.
'Against (touching)' and 'into (in collision with)' are essentially the same directional meaning of tegenaan, so this duplicates the other sense.
This duplicates item 2, since the day-to-day business of a caretaker government is the same expression; the 'regering van lopende zaken' phrase is covered by it.
The meaning 'administration' duplicates the other 'management' meaning and adds nothing for a learner.
Fungus duplicates the "mould" meaning, so it is redundant.
to send for posten (mail a letter) largely duplicates the other meaning "to post", so this adds nothing.
Pressure is not a real sense of drang beyond the urge meaning, so it duplicates or confuses the 'urge' meaning.
Misery is an archaic/obscure sense and the common meanings poverty and penury are already listed.
Graphite is already covered by the 'graphite powder' meaning and the example is about the pencil core, so this duplicates another sense and is not a real meaning of potlood.
The 'immune (not liable)' sense duplicates this one and the medical meaning is the main one, so one of the two should go, and this item is the redundant duplicate.
This is a nominalized adjective that duplicates the meaning of "foremost one" already listed, so it adds nothing.
Billboard is a meaning of poster that largely duplicates the general poster meaning, and the example fits poster generally.
This duplicates the other uitdelen meaning, which is about handing out items, so one entry is enough.
'Mat' as checkmate is an adjective (mat zetten), not a noun 'het mat', and the example is a verb phrase, so this noun meaning is wrong.
mat does not mean mullet (that is "kuifje"/"vissen"-type hairstyle; Dutch uses "matje" or "matten" loosely), and rug and checkmate are already covered, so this sense is wrong and best dropped.
Slavernij means slavery, and 'oppression' is a loose duplicate of the other meaning; the article de is correct.
Aspirine as 'any tranquilizer' does not exist; aspirin is a painkiller, not a sedative.
'Granular particle' duplicates the general 'grain' meaning and is not a distinct sense of graan as normally used.
Uitvoering meaning 'export' is archaic and confusing; modern Dutch uses export or uitvoer.
It is a narrower duplicate of the general meaning 'cobra'.
Alongside duplicates the "along" meaning, which is already listed.
'base' (military base) is essentially the same meaning as barracks, so it duplicates the other meaning.
The gloss 'pickup' duplicates the existing meanings 'pickup (truck)' and 'record player'.
Any denim garment largely duplicates the pair-of-jeans meaning and is not a distinct sense.
Plain 'to ride' is just a vague repeat of the other doorrijden meanings and adds nothing.
'her' is an archaic or rare adverb whose meaning is essentially the same as 'here', so it only duplicates the other meaning and confuses learners.
tripodic is not a meaning of ruiter; the other listed meanings (rider, horseman, tab) already cover the real senses, so this one is wrong and should go.
'Rif' meaning corpse is archaic and obscure, and confusing for learners; the reef and skeleton senses remain.
'Rif' meaning skeleton is archaic and obscure, and it only confuses learners.
whipping is just another sense of zweep already covered by "whip", so it duplicates the existing meaning.
Funfair is already listed as another meaning, and this rare entry duplicates it (kermis is the usual word).
'To chew up' merely duplicates the existing meaning 'to chew'.
Duplicates the existing meaning 'unrest (state of agitation)'.
Gordijn means curtain; 'net curtain' (vitrage) is not a separate meaning and duplicates the other meaning.
'To study hard' is not a meaning of streven, and 'to strive' is already listed as another meaning.
'To ram' duplicates the other meaning 'to strike something hard', which covers the same sense.
Spell duplicates enchantment, which is already listed as the other meaning, and the example does not add a distinct sense.
The vague 'to lift' duplicates the more specific 'to lift and turn with a rake' and is an obscure technical sense.

column3: to lift and turn with a rake
column4: This is an obscure agricultural sense (turning hay) that would only confuse a learner.
Stunning cattle with a blow is an obscure, archaic sense of dollen that a learner is unlikely to need.
Concord is just a near-synonym of harmony, so this duplicates meaning 2, and 'de harmonie' is already correct.
An assembly sense of conventie is rare and overlaps with the convention meaning, so it only confuses learners.
Schoonmoeder means mother-in-law, not a boyfriend's mother in general, and this duplicates the other meaning.
It duplicates the other evenals entry; 'as well as' and 'just like' are the same conjunction meaning.
The gloss 'note' is vague and duplicates the two specific note meanings already listed.
'Act of charity' is not a real meaning of 'akte' (that would be 'daad'), so this obscure and wrong sense is dropped.
Essentially duplicates the 'to pause' meaning, which already covers pauzeren in the sense of taking a break.
It duplicates the other essence meaning, so it is dropped.
public is not a meaning of 'kas'; the real senses (greenhouse, counter, casing, cash) are already listed.
'Prefatory play' is just a variant of the 'prelude' meaning and is obscure, so it duplicates another meaning.
Carnivoran is a technical near-duplicate of carnivore and predatory species, which confuses learners.
The 'dragoon' sense is obscure and not the normal Dutch word (dragonder), so it only confuses a learner.
Treacle mustard is an obscure botanical sense of dragon that would only confuse a learner; the tarragon meaning is the useful one.
'Regime of terror' essentially duplicates the other listed meanings of terror and terrorism.
'Genteel' is a wrong sense of hip and the meaning essentially duplicates 'fashionable' (stylish).
'Vorst' meaning copse is not a real meaning (that is 'bosje'); it is obscure or wrong.
'To advocate' is not a normal meaning of aanbevelen and duplicates the recommending sense, which is listed separately.
The 'male heterosexual' sense is archaic and obscure, it duplicates another listed meaning, and it only confuses a learner.
blijk is only used in the phrase "blijk geven van"; "mark" and "token" are the same meaning, so keep one entry (item 2) and drop this duplicate.
The 'stature' meaning is archaic and doesn't really exist for this word, so it only confuses learners.
Duplicates the other meaning 'phenomenon'; the sense is the same.
'Any weed' is not a real meaning of ruit; the plant sense (Ruta) is already listed.
Tijdmachine means time machine, not chronometer; the 'chronometer' meaning does not exist and the real meaning is already listed.
Archaic blade sense duplicates the 'blade of grass' meaning and only confuses learners.
Archaic sense of spier as blade; 'geen spier' survives only in the fixed phrase, so it is obscure and duplicates the other blade meaning.
The sense 'weak' is the original Latin-derived meaning and is obscure and archaic today, so it only confuses a learner.
The 'subdue' meaning is archaic and only confuses a learner; modern bemachtigen means to get hold of.
slee means stale/flat or sour-tasting only in dialect; the standard adjective means blunt/stiff, so this obscure meaning only confuses a learner.
to go inside duplicates the other meaning "to enter", which covers the same sense.
It duplicates the 'approximately' meaning, as 'fifty odd' is just a rendering of the same sense.
'Fabrieken' as a verb meaning to build is not standard Dutch (the verb is fabriceren), and the example is wrong; the word is the plural of fabriek.
This meaning duplicates the other 'flora' meaning and the plant-book sense is the same word, so it only confuses.
'Klos' as a spirit drink does not exist; this meaning is spurious.
wooden is an adjective sense that does not exist for the noun klos, so it is not a real meaning of this noun.
local is not a meaning of sufferd, and the real meaning (fool) is already listed in item 3.

column3: to abstain from some (usually undesirable) action
column4: This meaning is not real as glossed: 'uitlaten' means to walk a dog or let out, not to abstain, and the example is ungrammatical.
Gerard is a given name that stays Gerard in English; the gloss 'George' is wrong and it duplicates the other meaning.
Blood plasma is the same as the general plasma meaning, so it duplicates another meaning.
A father of one's boyfriend is just a father-in-law in a loose sense and duplicates the other meaning, which is the correct one.
'Brutish' essentially duplicates the other meaning 'brutal' for bruut.
Insecurity and uncertainty overlap closely, so it duplicates the other meaning, and the example is odd.
The subatomic pion is already listed under de pion, and het pion is a wrong-article duplicate.
Cutie and darling are essentially the same meaning of dot, so this duplicates the 'darling' entry.
The gloss '25 °C' is not a translation, and the meaning duplicates 'summery'.
